name: E2E Portal Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Build Rust project
        run: cargo build --release

  e2e-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node & pnpm
        uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: pnpm exec playwright test --reporter=junit
        env:
          PORTAL_URL: ${{ secrets.PORTAL_URL }}
          PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PORTAL_URL }}
          # Add any other required env vars here

      - name: Upload Playwright test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-results
          path: test-results/

      - name: Report Playwright test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: Playwright Tests
          path: test-results/**/*.xml
          reporter: jest-junit
          artifact: playwright-results

  traffic-verification:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: e2e-tests
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Build traffic verification tool
        run: cargo build --manifest-path=./scripts/traffic_verification/Cargo.toml --release

      - name: Run traffic verification
        run: |
          ./target/release/traffic_verification \
            --portal-url ${{ secrets.PORTAL_URL }} \
            --log-file logs/traffic_verification.log
        env:
          # Any additional env vars required by the tool
          LOG_LEVEL: info

      - name: Upload traffic verification logs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: traffic-verification-logs
          path: logs/

  socks5-udp-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: traffic-verification
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Build imix_connect
        run: cargo build --manifest-path=./imix_connect/Cargo.toml --release

      - name: Run SOCKS5 UDP test
        run: |
          # Start imix_connect with UDP support in the background
          ./target/release/imix_connect --udp --listen 127.0.0.1:1080 &
          IMIX_PID=$!
          sleep 5

          # Run a UDP client test (assumes a Rust binary or script exists)
          cargo run --manifest-path=./tests/socks5_udp/Cargo.toml --release

          # Capture exit status
          TEST_STATUS=$?

          # Stop imix_connect
          kill $IMIX_PID
          wait $IMIX_PID 2>/dev/null || true

          # Exit with the test status
          exit $TEST_STATUS
        env:
          # Any env vars needed for the test
          SOCKS5_PROXY: 127.0.0.1:1080

      - name: Upload SOCKS5 test logs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: socks5-udp-logs
          path: socks5-logs/
